queries_run: Airbnb market share gaining OR losing 2026 Booking Holdings Expedia vacation rental
Airbnb new entrant threat displace 2026 short-term rental competition

findings.claim: 10-K 列出競爭者含 OTA、搜尋引擎、meta-search、連鎖飯店、物業管理公司與體驗平台；並提到擁有既有消費者關係的對手可能打造「super-apps」進入旅遊市場，可能推高獲客成本；部分物業管理者鼓勵直訂繞過平台。
findings.excerpt: Competitors with established consumer relationships may leverage these to enter the travel market, creating “super-apps” that integrate multiple services, potentially increasing our customer acquisition costs and affecting our competitive position.

findings.claim: 10-K 稱 Airbnb 在吸引房東與房客上面臨高度競爭，房東常跨平台刊登。
findings.excerpt: Hosts have numerous options for listing their spaces, experiences, and services, both online and offline, and often cross-list their offerings.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋僅見二手部落格；KeyData 美國專業管理租屋 Q2 2026 Airbnb 預約占比 51%（前年 47%）、營收占比 43%（前年 36%）出自 redawning.com 單一來源，未讀到頁面故放 clues。未找到 2026 年特定新進入者搶 Airbnb 份額的來源。

clues.claim: KeyData Q2 2026：Airbnb 在美國專業管理租屋預約占 51%、營收占 43%，高於一年前的 47%／36%；Vrbo 超過 40% 預訂來自房東出資促銷
clues.source: Red Awning, vacation rental channel mix 2026
